summary.text: Todd Young has served in the U.S. Senate from Indiana since 2017, after three terms in the U.S. House beginning with his 2010 election.

paragraphs.text: He graduated from the U.S. Naval Academy in 1995, served in the U.S. Marine Corps, and was honorably discharged as a captain in 2000.
He earned an MBA from the University of Chicago, an MA from the School of Advanced Study in London, and a law degree from Indiana University; he lives in Johnson County, Indiana.
